body: [{"streamId":"01a0de88-1d58-703b-82e0-0fe56fe2f5a2","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a0de88-1d58-703b-82e0-0fe56fe2f5a2\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Effort is settable per session role on a node (h9k config set --effort-build through --effort-courier), once per project (h9k project set --effort), and once per task (h9k task revise --effort); a session\\u0027s effort resolves task, then project, then the node\\u0027s role value, then the node-wide --effort, then the model\\u0027s own default, and h9k config show and h9k daemon status show every role\\u0027s value and origin\u0022},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022h9k config set accepts --effort-build, --effort-fix, --effort-review, --effort-review-verify, --effort-review-finalpass, --effort-synthesis, --effort-refinement, --effort-publication, and --effort-courier, each taking low, medium, high, xhigh, or default to clear; review-verify and review-finalpass fall through to review\\u0027s value before anything below it, matching how their models resolve; the existing node-wide --effort keeps its meaning as the level beneath every role value\u0022,\u0022A project and a task each carry one optional effort: h9k project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --effort \\u003Clevel|default\\u003E and h9k task revise \\u003Cid\\u003E --effort \\u003Clevel|default\\u003E; a session\\u0027s effort resolves in this order, the first level set wins: the task\\u0027s value, then the project\\u0027s value, then the node\\u0027s value for the session\\u0027s role (for a verify or final pass: the pass value, then review\\u0027s), then the node-wide value, then unset so the model\\u0027s own default decides; h9k project show and h9k task show print the value when set; the project\\u0027s value is stored beside the project\\u0027s model in the node-scoped project settings event and never replicates, and the task\\u0027s value is stored on the task like its model and travels with the task\u0022,\u0022Every session the daemon launches gets its effort resolved at the dispatch site by a DaemonOptions resolver over the role, the task\\u0027s value, and the project\\u0027s value (with verify and final-pass variants), carried on the spawn request as a required field beside Model so no site can forget it, and written by the executor into the settings file as effortLevel; h9k task start and h9k task delegate, which write their own settings files from the CLI, resolve the build effort beside their build-model resolvers over the same chain; a session with nothing set at any level leaves the key out of the file exactly as today; the interactive role and a person\\u0027s own h9k pr review lap are excluded and honor the person\\u0027s user-level setting\u0022,\u0022The four level names and the resolution chain live in the domain as vendor-neutral values (AgentEffort and the resolve function), with the Claude Code effortLevel key known only to the Claude executor and the CLI\\u0027s settings-file writer; no vendor string appears in the domain or in the stored settings, so a second executor adds one mapping and touches no resolution code\u0022,\u0022h9k config show prints one effort line per role beneath the node-wide line, each naming its value and origin (config file, environment, or which level it falls through to), and h9k daemon status prints the same rows for the settings a daemon started now would bind, in the same shape the per-role model lines already use\u0022,\u0022A test over the resolve function proves the chain with a task value winning over a project value, a project value winning over a node role value, a role value winning over the node-wide value, one role falling through to unset, and review-verify falling to review; a test over the settings-file writer proves the resolved value lands as effortLevel and an unset one leaves the key out; the existing node-wide effort tests still pass unchanged\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Brian, 2026-09-26, in the hall9k project window, after reviewing the Mac\\u0027s model settings: he wants effort per role, the same shape the per-role model settings already have, plus one override at the project and one at the task, the further down the higher the priority. Walked and challenged 2026-09-26; verdict in this task\\u0027s journal.md. Verified against main at a1237be0e. Today: OperatingSettings.Effort and DaemonOptions.Effort hold one node-wide value (low, medium, high, xhigh; null leaves the key out so the model\\u0027s own default decides); ClaudeExecutor near line 58 writes AgentEffort.FromInput(options.Value.Effort) into every session\\u0027s settings file via ClaudeSettingsFile.Build (effortLevel key, src/Hall9k.Connectors/Prompts/ClaudeSettingsFile.cs near line 100). The executor cannot resolve task or project values: AgentSpawnRequest (src/Hall9k.Daemon/Execution/IExecutor.cs) carries TaskId and no project id, and Model already arrives pre-resolved from each of the sixteen dispatch sites, which hold task.Model and project.Model; effort travels the same way. TaskStartCommand.cs near line 204 and TaskDelegateCommand.cs near line 124 write their own settings files from the CLI and resolve the build model over the OperatingSettingsReport (TaskStartCommand.ResolveBuildModelAsync near line 636); PullRequestReviewCommand.cs near line 1317 writes one for a person\\u0027s own lap and is excluded. Pattern to mirror: RoleModelSettings (OperatingSettings.cs near line 332, nine nullable strings, AsPairs) bound by name to RoleModelDefaults on DaemonOptions near line 886, ModelByRole.For(role), ResolveModel near line 799, ResolveVerifyReviewModel near 813 and ResolveFinalFullPassReviewModel near 840 (task, then the pass knob, then review\\u0027s chain), ConfigSetCommand\\u0027s --model-build through --model-courier options near lines 93 to 132, and OperatingSettingsRendering.Rows near lines 64 to 78, whose fall-through text serves both config show and daemon status without touching SettingOrigin. Storage: a RoleEffortSettings beside RoleModelSettings; Optional\\u003CAgentEffort\\u003E Effort on ProjectSettingsChanged (node-scoped, EventScopeRegistry.cs near line 256, the same half the project\\u0027s model lives in, so it never replicates and cannot collide with the team-settings ordering fix of 1629bc9d); Optional\\u003CAgentEffort\\u003E Effort on TaskRevised (project-scoped, near line 99, travels like the task\\u0027s model). Scope reminder for the builder: node and project effort are local to the node that set them; a task\\u0027s effort travels with the task and wins on every node. Effort per model was considered and rejected at the walk. The model chain\\u0027s own reorder (project above node role) is task f8fe7435, not this one; do not change model resolution here. Placement: the Mac. Dispatched sessions must not run install, update, join, or reconcile against the live install. No em dashes in anything authored.\u0022},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-09-26T16:58:48.292076\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"57a5c7d4-5a77-41b0-84eb-e49694137959","originSequence":66131,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-09-26T16:58:48.302283+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
